overview.short: St. Sebastian’s Church in Dilshad Garden, East Delhi, is a prominent Catholic parish known for its serene community campus and proximity to Trans-Yamuna heritage.
overview.description: Established in 1980 under the Archdiocese of Delhi, St. Sebastian’s Church in Dilshad Garden is a prominent Christian spiritual sanctuary in East Delhi. Dedicated to Saint Sebastian, the parish is celebrated for its festive Christmas and Easter gatherings, peaceful interior, and community welfare services. Located near the historic trans-Yamuna quarter of Shahdara, the surrounding area offers lush recreational spaces like Surajmal Park, Yamuna Sports Complex, and Sanjay Lake.
overview.about: The church serves thousands of parish families across East Delhi and NCR. Visitors can combine visits to the church with exploring ancient Mughal-era markets in Shahdara, serene lakes, and the sprawling cultural campus of Akshardham.

howToReach.roadNote: Conveniently connected by Dilshad Garden Metro Station (Red Line). Grand Trunk Road (GT Road) provides direct access to Central Delhi and Ghaziabad.
